titre: Les métiers de la beauté recrutent plus vite que l'ensemble de l'économie
sous_titre: Croissance projetée de l'emploi aux États-Unis, en %, entre 2025 et 2035

Esthéticiennes.texte: Employment of skincare specialists is projected to grow 9 percent from 2025 to 2035

Prothésistes ongulaires.texte: Employment of manicurists and pedicurists is projected to grow 9 percent from 2025 to 2035

Coiffeurs et barbiers.texte: Overall employment of barbers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists is projected to grow 7 percent from 2025 to 2035

Ensemble des professions.texte: The average growth rate for all occupations is 3 percent.
